data.name: Guillema
data.gender_notes: Guillema is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'guilē', meaning 'yielding, willing, or desiring'. In Christian tradition, it represents determination and strong will in the face of adversity. The name Guillema carries the meaning “Will, desire, determination” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Guillema usually hope their child will grow to embody will, desire, determination and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner strength and determination needed to follow one's spiritual path.
data.etymology: Guillema belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Will, desire, determination.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Guillema total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: גוילהמה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גוילהמה הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא הכוח שלי'. השם נגזר מהמילים 'אלוהים' ו'כוח', ומשמש כזכר לשם האלוהים וכוחו הנפלא.

in_greek.name: Γουιλέμα
in_greek.long_meaning: Γουιλέμα είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Θεός είναι η δύναμή μου'. Το όνομα αυτό αποτελεί έκφραση πίστης και προσήλωσης στο Θεό, καθώς και αναφορά στη δύναμη και τη μεγαλοσύνη του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Guillema
in_latin.long_meaning: Guillema est nomen femininum quod ex hebraeo origine trahit et significat 'Deus est mea virtus'. Hoc nomen est expressio devotionis et firmitatis in Deum, necnon etiam commemoratio potentiae et maiestatis Dei.

in_english.name: Guillema
in_english.long_meaning: Guillema is a feminine given name of Hebrew origin, meaning 'God is my strength'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'El' (God) and 'koach' (strength). This name is an expression of faith and devotion to God, reflecting the importance of spiritual strength and trust in divine providence. Historically, the name Guillema has been used in various Christian cultures, symbolizing the virtue of faith and the empowerment that comes from a deep connection with God.
